clues: This city grew from a small fishing town on the Songhua River. It is now a big city in northeast China.
Its winters are bitterly cold, so cold that ice art is a big draw. The cold season shapes the whole city's fun.
It was founded in 1898 when a Russian-built railway came. Most of its first people came from the Russian Empire.
In the 1920s, styles from Paris and Moscow came here first. This city was China's top place for fashion.
Look for old Russian-style buildings and a strong European feel. Few cities in China look quite like this one.
